admission.says: One declared schema for both doors; the stable request_id names the phase, and a replay is recognised before the Work guard.

request.says: The canonical effect-bearing content a replay must repeat exactly; the child id derives from (parent, finding). An omitted optional child field is absent from the request, never defaulted.

steps.effect: PENDING phase row: the request, its guard (basis_revision) and the original actor.
Create the child once per (parent, finding) with followup_origin; an existing child must still match the request.
Apply the closure once; an existing join is reused.
COMPLETE or PENDING_JOIN phase row; recovered_by names another admitted actor that completed it.

shared_effects.says: The same effect sequence serves the first request and every recovery.

closures.optional: membership only: the child is contained by the parent
closures.required: a closure obligation on the parent: its completion waits for the child
closures.prerequisite: the parent depends on the child

guards: recovery only while the parent differs by this request's own join (project_work_review._own_change_only)
composition.recovery: Repeat the same request: review.pending_joins[].recover with the current expected_work_revision. Nothing is deleted or re-run.
composition.evidence: Phase rows (view:review phase_id) and the owner's combined append receipt when contiguous.

authority.native: the admitted writing turn; review mode records reviews and follow-ups only

work_review.requires: Name phase and a stable request_id. A handoff or self-assessment never satisfies an obligation; nothing is launched.

mechanical: Exact consumed scope and completion evidence
acceptance.parent_completion: Containment alone is not a completion dependency; only authored prerequisites are enforced.

basis.scope: Each action consumes only its own guards; an activity or observation change renews or stales none.

carrier.says: The exact handles, guards, admitted statuses and refusals, phase preparation, effects and recovery of these actions.

needs.says: Declared prerequisites: completion waits for each to be done on current acceptance.

affects.says: Work that declares this as a prerequisite.

required.answers: exact revisions, allowed actions, blockers and relationships

context.refine: Read only what the chosen action consumes; a missing or changed basis refuses with exact next reads.

observation.door: human attestation only; the native door has no observation write
observation.says: Record what an actual dispatcher or actor-status read showed, with its own time and a bounded expiry. Never a heartbeat: record only actual status events. A completed observation completes no Work.

origin.says: No recorded follow-up origin: this Work relates only through its declared containment and prerequisites.

evidence.says: Completion evidence reads are in the detail; review-phase evidence and pins are the exact phase reads in the history.

scope.says: The local owned workspace: every namespace this root holds is readable here.
